title: Simulations of dislocation dynamics on an atomic lattice: the effect of collision rules
summary: The stochastic dynamics of dislocations on a one-dimensional periodic lattice domain are considered. Two models are studied: one without a collision rule, and one which annihilates colliding dislocations if they have opposite orientation. The behaviour of both models is investigated by means of a series of numerical simulations exploring the asymptotic behaviour of these models as the number of dislocations increases.
